subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Rajesh says to Malini, "We did not like the dance last year."

options.text: Rajesh tells Malini that they had not liked the dance the previous year.
Rajesh tells Malini that they did not like the dance the previous year.
Rajesh told Malini that they did not like the dance last year.
Rajesh told Malini that they had not liked the dance the previous year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
